history.summary: Split follows time spent and client-requested rework, with a small lift for Sora because the voice was central to the brief and was redone twice.

reasons.text: Wrote the script and did two client-requested revisions (165 min total).
Client feedback on the intro and ending was addressed in v2 and v3.
Most hours: four edit cuts, export and color pass (265 min).
Fixed subtitle overflow the client flagged.
Recorded the voiceover, a required part of the brief.
Re-recorded the full voiceover twice for a warmer tone at the client's request.

disputes.text: I should get 70% because editing is the hardest part.
disputes.answer: Jun asked for 70% because editing is hardest, but the log does not show that. It does show Jun with the most minutes (265 of 506, events e07, e09, e11, e13, e14), so Jun goes from 50% to 52%, not 70%.

reasons.text: Wrote the script and did two revisions after client feedback (165 min).
